lifecycle.prepare: require exact absent or exact owned state plus native transport, two-flag isolation and sanitized proxy facts
lifecycle.apply: from one exact clean commit atomically install one runtime and plist, bootstrap one user LaunchAgent, require an HTTP 101 proxy handshake and write a hash-bound private receipt; a validator-only correction may rebind only that receipt after all exact live gates pass
lifecycle.doctor: require exact files and receipt, loaded LaunchAgent, both SSH-session flags and an HTTP 101 WebSocket upgrade through the live Windows proxy

lifecycle.rollback: boot out only the exact label, require the proxy to disappear and remove only receipt-hash-matched files
lifecycle.failure: boot out the fresh job and remove only exact newly created files; drift fails closed
